title: Automated Corporate Training Video Localization
business: A global enterprise training department producing onboarding materials for international staff.
problem: The team spends excessive manual hours transcribing, editing, and re-syncing video content for different regional offices, leading to significant bottlenecks in training deployment.
solution: By integrating the Descript connector with Claude, the team can use natural language prompts to automate the editing process, including transcribing source videos, removing filler words, and triggering translation workflows directly within the Claude interface.
steps: Authenticate the Descript connector within the Claude interface to establish a secure link to the project workspace.
Use the import_media tool to upload raw training footage into the Descript project environment.
Issue a prompt to the Claude agent to identify and remove filler words or silence from the transcript.
Invoke the prompt_project_agent to generate translated captions or localized audio overlays for specific regional requirements.
Monitor the progress of the editing tasks using the get_job tool to ensure all production steps complete successfully.
outcome: The training department achieves a streamlined production pipeline where video edits are handled via conversational instructions, significantly reducing the time required to prepare localized content for global onboarding.
limitation: The connector relies on asynchronous job processing; users must manually poll the status of long-running edits using the get_job tool, as Claude does not automatically receive push notifications when a complex video render is finished.

questions.question: In Automated Corporate Training Video Localization, what is the primary benefit of using the Descript connector?

options: The connector cannot handle video files larger than 10MB.
The system requires manual polling of job status because it lacks automatic push notifications.
The connector only supports Spanish translation.
The system requires a separate subscription to the Descript API for every single edit.
